title: Tesseract Platform Precision Profile Reference
description: Platform-facing reference to an Adaptive precision profile plus the recommendation metadata the platform needs. This is a RESERVED contract: the platform operates fully when no provider is installed.

profile_ref.description: Opaque identifier resolved by the Adaptive provider, e.g. adaptive://model/llama-3.1-8b/awq-int4.

quality_certificate_ref.description: Reference to a validated quality certificate. Absent means the profile is not quality-certified.

backend_compatibility.description: Runtimes/backends the profile is known to work with.
